summary: Extends the Owner Authorization Service to Ownership Review's closing package: owner_authorizations.scope also allows 'closing_packages'. Adds owner_authorization_request_closing_package(), which creates one numbered request of pending transfers with their settlement dates, prorations, capitalization fees and the package fingerprint. Adds accounting_run_approve_closing_package(), which approves the capitalization-fee journal-entry run under that authorization only for completed, authorized transfers at the authorized amounts. No rows are added, removed or changed; no transfer, charge or entry is touched.

preflight.name: the closing package request function does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'owner_authorization_request_closing_package'

preflight.name: no request uses an unknown scope
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM owner_authorizations WHERE scope NOT IN ('conversion_objects', 'accounting_runs', 'arc_acc_decisions')

expected_changes: owner_authorizations_scope_check now allows conversion_objects, accounting_runs, arc_acc_decisions and closing_packages.
Adds owner_authorization_request_closing_package(text, text, uuid, jsonb, text, text, integer), executable by service_role only.
Adds accounting_run_approve_closing_package(uuid, uuid, text, text), executable by service_role only.
No rows are added, removed or changed.

verify.name: both functions exist
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname IN ('owner_authorization_request_closing_package', 'accounting_run_approve_closing_package')

verify.name: the scope check allows closing packages
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'owner_authorizations_scope_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%closing_packages%'
